direct_full.label: Every machine pulls base+rescore from central

direct_weights_only.label: Weights-only release; dict reused via sha256 hard-link

court_mirrors_full.label: Court mirrors pull once per court (base+rescore)

chosen_design.name: Tier A local inference + central registry + court mirrors
chosen_design.note: Keystroke path never hits central. Central bill is egress+VM. Tier B boxes are capex where the hardware gate fails.

rejected_gpu_line.label: Always-on GPU inference API (rejected comparison line)
rejected_gpu_line.instances_for_500_concurrent_note: One g4dn.xlarge-class instance (~$380/mo) already consumes most of a $500 ceiling before redundancy, cannot serve 500 concurrent typists with headroom, and does not fix WAN latency or blackout.

what_breaks: Release-day egress grows with courts, not typists — mirrors still win.
Central poll load ~80 req/s of mostly 304s — still trivial.
Tier B multi-worker capacity and on-site ops become the hard part if hardware-gate fail rate is high.
Signed manifests + cohort rollout needed before fleet size makes a bad publish expensive.
